### ASTRAL Coalescent Homework with mock data

*ASTRAL description:*

ASTRAL is a coalescent modeling software used after inferring a gene tree in order to reconstruct the best fitting model of the species tree. 

*Assumptions:* 

- input gene tree in Newick format (allowed to have some missing elements, like taxa or unresolved branches)

- input tree sampled randomly under multi-species coalecent model

- presence of a gene is independent of gene tree topology and other genes from species

- ILS causes most inconsistencies


*Limitations:*

- inconsistent depending on gene tree quality

- inconsistent under conditions with gene trees evolving on a phylogenetic network


Commands used:

```
java -jar astral.5.7.8.jar -i test_data/simulated_14taxon.gene.tre -o output.tre
```
